summary.text: Joshua Ray Ashburn, an independent who says he is not a career politician, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House in Tennessee's 1st District to Diana Harshbarger.
His Ballotpedia profile lists no prior elected office or career details.

paragraphs.text: Ashburn says he is 36 years old and a father of two, and that he has been with his spouse for almost six years.
He describes himself as not a career politician; his Ballotpedia profile lists no prior elected office or career details, and he reports no endorsements.

During the campaign, he said he ran because he was tired of career politicians being re-elected, and he supported term limits, stronger border security, small businesses and farmers, and less U.S. involvement in foreign conflicts.
He received 1.0% of the vote to Diana Harshbarger's 67.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
